BiblicalUsage: Beraiah means "Jehovah has created." He was son of Shimhi, a chief man of Benjamin. You will find it in 1 Chronicles 8:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Beraiah is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
